n_star: <int> Total number of items across all classes.

classes.class_id: <int> Identifier of this class, ranging from 1 to N.
classes.n_i: <int> Number of items in this class.
classes.f_i: <int> Fixed setup cost incurred when this class is activated (negative value representing a profit reduction).
classes.d_i: <int> Knapsack capacity consumed when this class is activated.

items.item_id: <int> Identifier of this item within its class, ranging from 1 to n_i.
items.c_ij: <int> Profit earned by selecting this item.
